current_bottleneck: The 392a objective neighborhood is capped, but a context-frame audit found that H60 adds generic level/path signal over H30 without adding architecture. Longer H90+ does not add a clean incremental benefit, and simple history vol-of-vol still does not justify aggressive regime-width conditioning.
last_result_summary: 488 audited aligned validation targets across history lengths. Chronological ridge probes improved future mean-level R2 from 0.3445 at H30 to 0.4905 at H60, with path-move R2 moving from 0.4883 to 0.5095 and future-vov R2 from 0.5766 to 0.5954. H90+ did not improve further, and hist-vov/future-vov correlations remained weak or negative.
next_step_recommendation: Run exactly one H60 empirical-normal-score causal-memory AR experiment using the same vanilla transition FM core. If it cannot improve the 392a frontier, stop treating history length as the primary bottleneck.
current_best_note: Ties the official revised-suite 8/11 frontier with better residual geometry than 385a: level KS 10/25, median-bias fraction 20/25, bias magnitude 25/25, daily KS 25/25, conditionality pass, and cointegration pass. Architecture is unchanged; the change is a theoretically proper free-running path-energy score fine-tune anchored by FM.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
